scope: standalone source-only parser and pure existing-zone spec-shift builder

api.parse(text): Returns {kind:'edit', channel, canonical supported part, signed relative delta, amountSpecified, amountUnit:'points', verb}; {kind:'clarify', reason, question}; or {kind:'delegate', reason}.
api.buildEdit(zone, parsed): Returns an edit carrying the real zone_id, optional expect_name, and full metal/rough/clearcoat shift tuple; returns noop or invalid when it cannot make a safe change.

rules: Only explicit lower/reduce/decrease or raise/increase commands for metalness, roughness, or clearcoat with a complete supported part name produce an edit. The part lexicon is roof, hood/bonnet, left/right side/panel, bumper/front bumper/rear bumper, trunk/boot, bed/truck bed, and spoiler.

Omitted amounts default to 20 relative points. Explicit amounts require 'by N points'; signed-negative inputs, percentages, absolute targets, dangling quantities, and trailing/unconsumed words clarify rather than silently defaulting.
Builder adds the signed delta to the selected current zone shift and clamps to [-127,127]. It does not mutate the zone or specify finish, color, pattern, mask, or other material properties.
A single diagnostic prefix may precede one command. Questions, how-to requests, and negative/prohibitive wording delegate. Unknown/ambiguous scope and mixed edits clarify without producing an edit.

integration_boundary: Parent dispatch must route eligible explicit material-only requests to this module, validate unique current helper-owned part-zone ownership and live identity, then pass buildEdit output through the ordinary guarded edit/Undo path. This module intentionally performs no owner lookup, queueing, rendering, or mutation.
